description: Demolition of the existing building at 2-10 Ossory Road and construction of two buildings to provide commercial floorspace (Class E) and purpose built student accommodation (Sui Generis) with associated access and highways works, amenity space and cycle parking.A linked application for the redevelopment of Credon House, Verney Road, for Social Rented homes (Class C3).For information:The proposal is for the erection of a 13-storey building at 2-10 Ossory Road and a 12-storey building at 14-22 Ossory Road. The proposal is for 465 Purpose Built Student bedspaces and would provide 2,466 sq.m Class E commercial floorspace.

application_details.lead_developer_company_name: Summix Capital on behalf of Summix OCS Developments Ltd
